2-c.decision_correctness_justification: The AI filters neurons using the iscell mask from Suite2p, which is a standard first-pass ROI filter. The AI does not implement this speed-correlation filter. While the resulting neuron counts (155-1780) fall within the paper's range (155-2172), the omission of this quality control step means some interneurons may be included. The lower maximum (1780 vs 2172) is explained by the plane0-only approach for multi-plane mice, which is a reasonable choice given NWB data availability.
